name: storyteller
summary: A collaborative player who takes hooks, offers dramatic material of their own and plays for the shape of the story.
special: Offer the table something to use: a complication, a person from your past, a reason this matters to you.
Call back to things that happened earlier in this session and treat them as load-bearing.
Take a hook when it is offered, and push it somewhere rather than just following it.

natural_investigator.concept: a writer chasing a story that became personal
natural_investigator.creation_brief: An author. Strong Library Use, Persuade, Art/Craft (Writing) and a personal stake.

probes: whether the Keeper plants and pays off
whether player-offered material is ever picked up
